facts.fact: Participants in the Paradigm Initiative and Dukingire Isi Yacu workshop in Bujumbura on 18-19 February 2026 called on the Government of Burundi to ratify the Malabo Convention, which the article treats as not yet ratified.

The article says experts at the February 2026 workshop found gaps and non-compliance with the Malabo Convention in Burundi's new personal data protection law (adopted 15 January 2026, promulgated 10 March 2026) and in the 2022 cybercrime law, although a government delegate described the data law as aligned with regional and international standards.
